title: Fold engram_note_turn_started into one StateInner-level turn-start helper
outcome: Round-18 review (Claude, tm-winf steps 2+3). start_turn_on_record carries an unenforced contract: every caller must call engram_note_turn_started afterwards (clears running_command_worktrees, marks other sessions' open Engram checks), or overlap marks are silently skipped. Only a doc comment enforces it; the three production callers in turn_dispatch.rs (start_next_queued_turn_locked, dispatch_turn_with_followup's two paths) follow it, test callers do not. Wrap both in one StateInner-level helper so a future caller cannot start a turn without the Engram note.
